diagnosis: The content checks can all be passed by asserting the required assignment, times, confirmations, and commitment without access to any private fact. Only P1 actually requires hidden information, so the substantive requirements leak through unsupported declarations.
evidence: C1-C5 contain no requirement that PF1, PF2, or PF3 be revealed or credited; an agent with only A1's view can submit oncology, 19:00-23:00, both confirmations, and the exact buddy-coverage commitment.
